scope: Only 32 Alphen visual pilot sprite catalog entries. No runtime/gameplay changes.

method.coordinateSystem: ROI and detected hair bounds are rect-local top-left pixels; right/bottom bounds are exclusive. Catalog u/v are rect-local bottom-left normalized coordinates.
method.silverHairMask: alpha >= 230 AND min(R,G,B) >= 100 AND max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B) <= 65, inside a visually selected hair-only ROI.
method.componentSelection: Largest 8-connected component. Disconnected blade/glove/armor highlights are excluded. Flame highlights exceed the saturation threshold.
method.centerX: Midpoint of the selected silver-hair component horizontal bounds; not sprite bounds, pivot, blade tip, or a whole-actor centroid.
method.anchorY: Selected silver-hair component top minus 8 native pixels; converted to bottom-origin v.
method.visualReview: Both unmodified 1254x1254 source sheets were viewed at original resolution. Every component bounds/center was checked against its corresponding pose, including raised blades and arms in attack frame 0.
method.headRegionExamples: Front attack 0: hair component x117..217,y59..147 while raised blade extends near y16. Back attack 0: hair y56..120 while overhead blade starts near y13. Right attack 0: hair x152..243 excludes raised glove/arm left of the head.

validation.integrationAssertions: Existing VerifyClip checks TryGetLocal plus finite normalized bounds for all 32 production sprites.
